exceptions.reason: Finite context-appropriate named-unit domains. Context, answer order, seed, identity and choice-bank changes do not add mathematical tasks. Previously shown or reserved tasks never return to fresh inventory.

difficulty_evidence.easy: Explicit labels on seven source prompts; five have complete valid fields and solutions. Includes atomic and volume unit labels.
difficulty_evidence.moderate: Bounded authored extension combines observed powered length units and non-time count input: U^k/V, k=2 or 3. Same first-derivative quotient, response shape and four solution stages; no new operations.
difficulty_evidence.hard: Observed farmer has compound input currency/quantity, so U/(V/U)=U^2/V. Original is unrated and erroneous; corrected generated bank and bounded authored units preserve its structure. Hard assignment reflects compound-unit workload; no source hard label is claimed.
